title: Your Eyes Need a Window
text: Screens do not damage eyes for ever, but tired eyes make bad afternoons. Doctors suggest a simple rule for study time: after twenty minutes, look at something far away for twenty seconds. A window is enough; a wall is not. Blinking matters too, because we blink less than half as often in front of a bright screen. Dry eyes feel like sand. Put the screen a little below eye level and keep a lamp behind you, not in front of the glass.
